dedupe_keys.name: primap2 climate policy data preparation toolkit

description: PRIMAP2 is a Python toolkit from the PRIMAP community for climate-policy data structures and processing. It defines an xarray-based format and functions to aggregate, interpolate and package emissions or related scenario data with searchable metadata. Users supply policy, inventory or scenario tables and variable definitions; outputs are structured datasets suitable for analysis or model input. Geographic coverage and years depend on the source files. Apache-2.0 code, PyPI installation and public documentation are available. The README says some planned package features remain under development, so users should check which transformations are implemented in the current release. A limitation is that aggregation or interpolation cannot establish the correctness of reported emissions or reconcile incompatible sector boundaries automatically. PRIMAP2 can prepare emissions trajectories for energy and transport decarbonisation simulations. The related catalogue IPCC AR6 scenarios database is a distinct possible source, not a PRIMAP2 product. No emissions dataset or Python package was downloaded.
